criteria.requirement: Implement the d parsing token as ISO weekday 1 through 7, converting to the same zero-based day_of_week used by ddd/dddd. Preserve existing first matching weekday in the epoch, selected year/month and complete-date precedence rules. Reject zero/eight and unsupported extra width rather than silently returning Monday. Keep named weekdays, formatting, locale behavior and all other tokens unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
